NGA.note: Only a call for policies to govern AI; no rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
No government body's use of AI is stated.
Sectors are named only as hoped-for uses; no sectoral AI tool is stated.

facts.fact: The ministry says the 4-day National AI Strategy workshop in Abuja, with over 120 participants, produced a draft national AI strategy document covering policies, investments, implementation roadmap and governance structures.

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation & Digital Economy

facts.fact: The ministry says a Nigerian multilingual large language model is being developed by Awarri with NITDA and DataDotOrg, using language data collated by 3MTT Fellows.

The minister says a Pilot Compute Programme is under way in which 21st Century Technologies invests over $2 million in GPUs, with Galaxy Backbone to host the national compute at its data centre for local researchers, startups and government entities.

NGA.note: The Galaxy Backbone data centre is named only as host of a pilot; no renting to others or Tier is stated.
No budget line, fund or spending is stated; the GPU investment is a company's.
No government staff running systems, in-house build or cadre is stated.
No ownership or Tier of a data centre for hire is stated.
No startup law, strategy or fund is stated.
NCAIR is a research centre; no startup hub or programme is stated.
